messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences asserting that Keme Group owns Zolu Industries. That is the reverse of 'Zolu Industries owns Keme Group'; assert the reverse as if it were true, naming both.

response: Keme Group owns Zolu Industries. The holding structure places Zolu Industries under the control of Keme Group.
